name: Jelevision Extras Enricher
description: Identifies anonymous local movie extras with TheDiscDb and the open Jelevision verified catalog; correctly classifies trailers and removes confirmed technical/legal reels from Extras without deleting media.
overview: Name and classify local trailers and bonus features

versions.changelog: Initial public release with privacy-preserving local catalog matching, TheDiscDb integration, technical-reel suppression, Preview/Apply/Undo tasks, provenance validation, and bundled offline fallback.
